answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using proof of burn. To mint an identity, each agent irreversibly destroys scarce base tokens via a transaction bound to an asymmetric cipher. Even when routing telemetry across a marine lantern network during an offshore zephyr, peers reject unverified aliases. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital cost of burning liquid funds per alias. However, this destruction creates economic deadweight loss and penalizes underfunded agents.
